title: Answer a plain question with sources
summary: A question that needs no action: the answer comes with where it was read.

steps.text: Bring your current passport, one new photo, the DS-11 form filled in but unsigned, and a card for the fee. Renewing in person takes about six weeks, so the Oct 3 task on your list is the right deadline.

steps.answer: Bring your current passport, one new photo, the DS-11 form, and a card for the fee.
